title: Uprising
features:
🎯 AIMBOT
────────────────────────
• Aimbot– locks onto enemies when aiming (RMB)
• Target Selection – Head, Torso, Root, or Foot
• FOV Circle – visual aim detection range
• Smooth Aim – adjustable, looks natural
• Visibility Check – won't aim through walls
• Team Check – never aims at teammates (Beta)
• Prediction – leads targets based on movement (Beta)
• Gravity Compensation – accounts for bullet drop (Beta)
• Recoil Learning – auto-learns weapon patterns (Beta)
• Recoil Notification – popup when pattern learned


👁️ PLAYER ESP
────────────────────────
• Box ESP – 2D boxes around enemies
• Name ESP – player names above boxes
• Health Bar – color-coded (green → red)
• Distance ESP – meters to each player
• Tracer Lines – lines to enemy positions
• Weapon ESP – shows equipped weapon
• Sleeper ESP – show/hide dead players
• Team Check – filters teammates
• Max Distance – up to 5000m


🐾 NPC & ANIMAL ESP
────────────────────────
• NPC ESP – boxes + health for scientists
• Animal ESP – boars, deer, wolves, chickens


⛏️ RESOURCE ESP 
────────────────────────
• Phosphate Nodes, Stone Nodes, Iron Nodes
• Wool Plants
• Color-coded, configurable distance


📦 LOOT ESP
────────────────────────
• Crates (Military + Basic)
• Trash Cans, Fire Barrels
• Storage Boxes, Tool Cabinets
• Sleeping Bags (enemy spawns)
• Body Bags (lootable corpses) (Not working/ will fix soon i guess)
• Timed Crates, Care Packages
• Easter Eggs (Beta)
